description: R/IV transaction.verify — independent evidence-verification primitive for verification. Completed paid execution returns an RVO plus signed R/IV Verification Receipt.

evidence_records.description: Evidence records supporting the claimed action, workflow, transaction, or control. Each record is an object describing one piece of evidence, such as a log entry, receipt, or observation.

expected_amount.description: The amount the transaction is expected to be, as a number in the stated currency. R/IV checks the evidence against this amount.

expected_currency.description: The currency of the expected amount, as an ISO 4217 code such as USD. The amount is meaningless without its currency.

request_id.description: Caller-generated idempotency key for this paid execution attempt.

transaction_claim.description: The transaction claimed to have happened, described in plain language, including who paid whom and for what.

name: transaction.verify

outputSchema.description: Schema of a completed R/IV machine execution. Cryptographic receipt integrity does not independently establish the truth of any underlying conclusion. Free trials may use a separate contract.

result.description: R/IV Verification Object with evidence, limitations, verdict and resultHash.

outputSchema.title: R/IV Machine Verification Result v2 - authenticated paid execution

x-riv-receipt-policy.integrity: server-side HMAC verification required for v1 receipts
x-riv-receipt-policy.meaning: signed provenance and execution integrity; not evidence that an underlying claim is true
